reviewer: Claude (independent read-only frozen-source review; not the adapter, decoder or recipe author)
verdict: The frozen input-trace leaf adds a read-only passive tap. The adapter diff is only the silent init, the once-only header behind the active T2 poll guard, and the trace call before the unchanged routeTrackpad. The selector's eligibility equals m1tp_child_input. Payload reads stay in bounds and the borrowed payload is not retained. The old T2 include and every other frozen input are unchanged. Source acceptance only: not an SDK build, KC, packet or runtime result, and it does not authorize a boot.

checks.S1_frozen_inputs_unchanged: PASS. All 23 sources in integrations/puredarwin/m1-trackpad-child/source-manifest.json still hash to their recorded values. The 25 SDK inputs all match live bytes. Compared by name with the child's 23, the set adds only m1tp_trace.c and m1tp_trace.h and changes only CMakeLists.txt, PDM1SPIHID.cpp and PDM1SPIHID.h. PDM1SPIHIDChild.inc 7e51fb0a, PDM1SPITrackpad.cpp 5dd0bf41, PDM1SPITrackpad.h 1d2c2241, child_state.h 991922e8, m1tp_child_policy.c/.h, the keyboard sources and dl_spi_hid.c/.h 88f2ae23/c58d84b1 are the frozen bytes.
checks.S2_patch_reproduces_leaf: PASS. input-trace.patch applied with patch -p1 to a scratch copy of the frozen child CMakeLists.txt, PDM1SPIHID.cpp and PDM1SPIHID.h produces files byte-equal to the leaf's adapter/CMakeLists.txt, adapter/PDM1SPIHID.cpp, adapter/PDM1SPIHID.h, core/m1tp_trace.c and core/m1tp_trace.h.
checks.S3_adapter_diff_scope: PASS. Against the frozen child adapter, PDM1SPIHID.cpp adds 20 lines and removes none; PDM1SPIHID.h adds 3 and removes none. The additions are: m1tp_trace_init in init(); in poll(), after the existing stopping, published and t2Enabled-with-t2Phase==1 early returns, a header IOLog guarded by t2Enabled and m1tp_trace_announce; self->traceTrackpad(&message) immediately before the unchanged self->routeTrackpad(&message) in the existing device-2/0x20/0x10 branch; and the traceTrackpad definition. The header gains the m1tp_trace.h include, the per-instance state member and the method declaration. CMakeLists.txt only appends m1tp_trace.c to the source list.
checks.S4_no_write: PASS. The new code (comments excluded) calls only IOLog, m1tp_trace_init/announce/select/hex, memset and dlsp_crc16. It has no writePacket, dlsp_request, waitResponse, m1tp_claim_request, setReport, getReport, Feature/Output/mode/0xd9/device-3 reference, timer, sleep or async dispatch. The five GET keys remain exactly (1,0xd0), (2,1), (0x10,1), (2,2), (0x10,2), in order, and no waitResponse, writePacket, handleReport, routeTrackpad, m1tp_child_input or m1kbd_keyboard_input line was removed or changed.
checks.S5_eligibility_equivalence: PASS. m1tp_trace_select returns 0 unless the header was announced, the message is device 2, flags 0x20, command 0x10, payload is non-null with length 1..1752, and the length is exactly 8 for id 02, 17 for 3f or 1752 for 44. Any other id returns 0. That accepts the same set as m1tp_child_input (whose upper bound of 2038 is never reached by an accepted exact length). Device-1 input is handled earlier by m1kbd_keyboard_input and never reaches the branch.
checks.S6_selection_contract: PASS. 02: every exact-length 02 counts in seen02; the first 16 are reason 1 even with X or Y equal to 0x80; motion is X!=0x80 && Y!=0x80 && (X!=0 || Y!=0); after 16, only the first 02 with motion is reason 2, and only if no logged 02 had motion; motion_logged then blocks any further reserve. 3f: first 2; 44: first 1. The 20-record ceiling equals 16+2+1+1, so it never cuts a contract-allowed record. seq is incremented only when a record is emitted (from 1, without gaps). Counters saturate at UINT32_MAX.
checks.S7_payload_bounds: PASS. dlsp_crc16 reads exactly payload_length (at most 1752) bytes, inside the 2048-byte delivered buffer. m1tp_trace_hex refuses null, zero, >1752 or out-of-range index, and writes at most 64 bytes of input as 128 characters plus NUL into the caller's char[129]. The traceTrackpad loop runs index 0..(bytes+63)/64-1, which is exactly the accepted index range (28 chunks for 1752, the last 24 bytes). No stack array is larger than 129 bytes and the 1752-byte report is never copied.
checks.S8_lifetime_and_ownership: PASS. dl_spi_hid.h documents the payload as borrowed until the next push or reset. traceTrackpad reads it synchronously through a const pointer before routeTrackpad and before poll calls receive again. m1tp_trace_record holds no pointer. trackpadTrace is a per-instance member, cleared in init() and changed only by m1tp_trace_announce and m1tp_trace_select, whose only callers are poll() and traceTrackpad() on the IOTimerEventSource action of the existing workloop. The probe stays a sole attempt per boot. No heap allocation, retain, release or new owner is added; the existing per-report IOBufferMemoryDescriptor in routeTrackpad is unchanged.
checks.S9_dispatch_unchanged: PASS. traceTrackpad returns void, never returns early from poll, and does not touch childObserved, childRejected, childSubmitted, t2Dispatches, the child sink or fault state. routeTrackpad is called for every message in that branch exactly as before. Only timing changes, from synchronous IOLog output.

residuals: traceTrackpad still ignores the m1tp_trace_hex return value, and hex is uninitialized. The selector's guarantees make the failure case unreachable today; if it ever happened, the following %s would read an unterminated stack buffer. Low severity, not a blocker; zero-initializing hex would close it.

IOLog is synchronous on the poll workloop. One 44 record is 30 lines (about 5 KB) printed in one poll pass, so keyboard and trackpad dispatch is delayed for that time. The device holds ready low, so input is delayed but not lost. Record any visible lag as an observation.

Per root, DL24 lines may interleave with the unchanged LIVE120 supervisor's DL23 exports. A LIVE grading failure caused by that stays a LIVE failure; the DL24 proof is graded separately, with record CRC, source, cycle, same-boot descriptor and Linux bindings.
The header prints on the first active T2 poll even if no report ever arrives. Zero records means no reports were observed, not a pass. Records show which reports the device sent, not who touched it.
